title: Macos compilation error double scrollbar
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproductible 4.6.1
- Not reproductible 4.5

### System information

Macos tahoe 26.3

### Issue description

Compilation error when compiling engine with double enabled:

```
scene/gui/scroll_bar.cpp:57:18: error: absolute value function 'fabsf' given an argument of type 'real_t' (aka 'double') but has parameter of type 'float' which may cause truncation of value [-Werror,-Wabsolute-value]
   57 |                                         scroll(-MAX(fabsf(pg->get_delta().x), get_step()));
      |                                                     ^
scene/gui/scroll_bar.cpp:57:18: note: use function 'std::abs' instead
   57 |                                         scroll(-MAX(fabsf(pg->get_delta().x), get_step()));
      |                                                     ^~~~~
      |                                                     std::abs
scene/gui/scroll_bar.cpp:64:18: error: absolute value function 'fabsf' given an argument of type 'real_t' (aka 'double') but has parameter of type 'float' which may cause truncation of value [-Werror,-Wabsolute-value]
   64 |                                         scroll(-MAX(fabsf(pg->get_delta().y), get_step()));
      |                                                     ^
scene/gui/scroll_bar.cpp:64:18: note: use function 'std::abs' instead
   64 |                                         scroll(-MAX(fabsf(pg->get_delta().y), get_step()));
      |                                                     ^~~~~
      |                                                     std::abs
scene/gui/scroll_bar.cpp:72:17: error: absolute value function 'fabsf' given an argument of type 'real_t' (aka 'double') but has parameter of type 'float' which may cause truncation of value [-Werror,-Wabsolute-value]
   72 |                                 scroll(-MAX(fabsf(pg->get_delta().y), get_step()));
      |                                             ^
scene/gui/scroll_bar.cpp:72:17: note: use function 'std::abs' instead
   72 |                                 scroll(-MAX(fabsf(pg->get_delta().y), get_step()));
      |                                             ^~~~~
      |                                             std::abs
3 errors generated.

```

### Steps to reproduce

Compile with double

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

It's just compiling the engine.
